desc: The MK118 MOD 2-M is built for long-range precision and versatility, chambered in the highly efficient 6MM ARC. Offering flat trajectories, reduced recoil, and exceptional energy retention, this rifle is perfect for precision shooters, hunters, and tactical applications. Powered by the renowned PWS Long Stroke Piston System, it delivers unmatched reliability and reduced fouling, while the 3-setting Adjustable Gas System allows fine-tuning for optimal performance in diverse conditions, including suppressor use.
